title: Modified is not created
hook: A newly edited old file and a newly created file answer different searches.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Distinguish creation and modification date filters.

objective: Distinguish creation and modification date filters.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: A newly edited old file and a newly created file answer different searches. For recent edits, which field matters? Correct option: Modified date. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.

claims.text: The fixture stores both dates. A recently modified file may have been created long before; the field must match the question.
